title: Scrum Bind Tight Push As One (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the scrum is eight men as one
Bind tight, push as one, drive low
If one man stands tall, the scrum collapses

[Verse 1]
Front row, the props and the hooker, three
Locks behind, two engine room knees
Flankers and the eight, the back row drive
Eight bodies, sixteen legs, scrum alive

[Pre-Chorus]
Bind on the jersey, knuckles white tight
Hips below the shoulders, back flat right
Feet shoulder width, knees bent at ninety
Ready for the call, brace mighty

[Chorus]
Scrum bind tight push as one, son
Eight men one engine, the work begun
Drive low through the hips and the legs
The pack moves forward, the ball it begs

[Verse 2]
Crouch on the call, then bind on the call
Set on the call, hold the position tall
Push on the put in, drive through the chest
Win the ball back, son, give the pack rest

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the scrum tests character
Eight men sweating, eight men grafter
If one man eases up, the whole pack goes back
No passenger in the scrum, son, no slack

[Chorus]
Scrum bind tight push as one, son
Eight men one engine, the work begun
Drive low through the hips and the legs
The pack moves forward, the ball it begs

[Outro]
Bind tight, push as one
Eight men, one engine, never undone
Low hips, flat back, drive
Thats my boy, scrum alive
